title: The One Framework Every Engineer Should Know
summary: The MECE principle (Mutually Exclusive, Collectively Exhaustive) from McKinsey provides a structured approach to problem-solving, communication, and decision-making in engineering contexts including incident diagnosis, interview preparation, and providing status updates.
when-to-read: Read this when you need to communicate complex technical problems clearly, structure your thinking during troubleshooting, or ace technical interviews through organized reasoning. If you're looking for specific debugging tactics or tools rather than communication framework, consult observability or problem-solving articles instead.
